note: Frozen mtime-derived git provenance. mtime does not survive copying; this file does. The rewrite reads this instead of the reflog, which also makes it reproducible.

caveat.summary: collection_code_digest is FALSE about execution for 447 of 1741 episodes. git_commit and git_tree are correct.
caveat.cause: The working tree was AHEAD of HEAD for the first part of the run. The comprehensive collector was uncommitted when collection started and was committed as 8590f436 partway through, so episodes written before that point record a commit predating the code that produced them.
caveat.proof: Direct contradiction, not inference: `git show <commit>:scripts/collection/collect_go2_smoke.py | grep -c 'ground_size_m\|perturb_peak_n'` returns 0 for 1d652ae9 and cbf7a8ec and 5 for 8590f436 and e8630cd6. A collector without those arguments cannot emit a 168-column episode, and every episode here has 168 columns.
caveat.data_impact: None. All 1741 episodes ran the SAME working-tree code, which is exactly 8590f436's. The digest split is an artifact of when the commit landed, not of any change in what executed.
caveat.note: Third occurrence of this defect in one day, and the second on this box. The durable fix is to record the running process's own state rather than resolve a commit afterwards; see docs/state/lessons/experiment-design.md.
